Bharat Tiwari Encounter Case Sparks Legal and Political Debate

The encounter of Bharat Bhushan Tiwari in Bhojpur, Bihar, has led to significant legal and political developments. The Supreme Court is scheduled to hear the case, with a petitioner seeking a CBI inquiry and an independent expert committee. Meanwhile, Tiwari's father has demanded the transfer of the SP and a judicial inquiry, while political figures have visited the village, leading to public questioning and debate.
